summary.text: Return to Ravnica takes place on Ravnica, where the Guildpact has been broken and the guilds are left unbound and struggling for control of the plane.

It follows Jace Beleren, who goes into the depths of the city's underbelly in search of powerful magic, and who runs the Implicit Maze in the right sequence so that the guilds will not destroy one another.
When his telepathy stops the Maze, the Supreme Verdict is triggered and Jace becomes the new Guildpact, a living being.
